summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, announcing an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for June 16, 2026, to adopt a Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association. The record date for voting is May 8, 2026. The filing includes the proposed charter amendments, notice of meeting, and proxy card. This is a routine corporate governance matter involving a vote on updated governing documents, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, stake acquisitions, strategic changes, or unusual events. The filing does not affect shareholder value or trigger a risk-arb opportunity. Watch for shareholder approval of the charter amendments.
